intent: Close the operator-facing half of issue #1508 by making the Slice-1 approval pane inspect-and-refresh only: no fresh owner projection, pending row, or key chord may construct an approval.resolve action, while inbound approval history, selection, and externally owned resolution/outcome projections remain readable.

negative_controls.name: server-backstop-effect-is-detected

interface_mismatches: The bridge now rejects approval.resolve without effects, but the Bun shell still promotes a fresh approval-history boolean into approve, deny, dismiss, or mark-resolved actions.
Observed approval history and effect authority are distinct: the former may populate the read-only pane and history refresh, but cannot construct a local mutation command.
Inbound permission decisions, resolutions, outcomes, and history remain protocol observations owned by external runtime/governance paths and must not be deleted with the local affordance.
honest_blockers: This packet removes only local approval effect affordances. It does not prove owner context, seven-seat liveness, performance, packaging, or production cutover.
The protected live Helm process remains on its old source until a later isolated proof and explicit cutover.
The Terminal Guardian harness still uses a private but nonconforming socket name; the separate tmux-isolation packet will migrate it to the concrete CODEX_MANAGED_PURPOSE_PID naming scheme.
session_entry.rollback: Revert this packet commit to restore the previous TypeScript approval controls. No runtime state or stored approval history is migrated or deleted by this UI-only change.
